verdict.rationale: An app catalog with search and category filtering is a fair question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies. The pack only claims "thousands of applications" and names familiar apps like Firefox, Chrome, Discord, Steam and OBS Studio. It never describes a software store or catalog, nor any way to search it or filter it by category. Community mentions of typing in the Dash concern launching apps already installed, not browsing a catalog, so they are not credited here.
